title: mcpforge/v1 — kind: Server (module server)
description: NEEDS_HUMAN — the canonical field list awaits a worked *.server.yaml example from the user. 02 has NO worked `kind: Server` example anywhere; §2.2 shows only `kind: Tool`. Every field below is one 02 §4.1 states in PROSE about a module server: an independently versioned, independently releasable bundle with its own config namespace, credential scope, kill switch, version and release train, running in Mode A (in the gateway process, the default) or Mode B (standalone). Nothing here is invented beyond that prose, and the shape is held identical to core/shared/src/manifest/server.ts (W0-A4, which raised the same gap) so the type model and its runtime validator cannot drift. Deliberately PERMISSIVE where the prose is silent: additionalProperties is true, so an unforeseen field in a real server manifest is not rejected by a schema written without one to look at. Tighten this to additionalProperties: false once a worked example exists.

version.description: Independently versioned — that is what makes it a deployable artefact (02 §4.1).

mode.description: Mode A is in-process in the gateway and is the default; a bundle is PROMOTED to Mode B (own process) only when a promotion condition holds. Not 42 deployments (02 §4.1).

promotionReason.description: Required in spirit for Mode B — the reason, from 02 §4.1's promotion conditions: a different runtime, an auth boundary, a sensitivity class, a release cadence, or a wrapped vendor server.

steward.description: A named person. Optional here only because no worked example states whether it is mandatory for a Server as it is for a Tool.
